description: This classic American Fresh Squeezed Lemonade is the quintessential summer thirst-quencher, bursting with bright, tangy lemon flavor and just the right amount of sweetness. Made with simple, fresh ingredients, it's a wonderfully refreshing beverage perfect for picnics, barbecues, or simply enjoying on a warm afternoon. Its vibrant taste will transport you straight to a sunny day.

instructions.title: Prepare Simple Syrup
instructions.text: In a medium saucepan, combine 1 cup granulated sugar and 1 cup water. Heat over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar completely dissolves and the mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat and let cool completely, about 30 minutes. This creates a simple syrup that prevents sugar from settling.

instructions.title: Squeeze Fresh Lemon Juice
instructions.text: While the syrup cools, wash and halve the lemons. Using a citrus juicer, squeeze enough lemons to yield about 1.5 cups of fresh lemon juice. Strain the juice through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any pulp and seeds.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: In a large pitcher, pour the cooled simple syrup and the strained fresh lemon juice. Stir well to combine thoroughly.

instructions.title: Dilute to Taste
instructions.text: Add 3 cups of cold water to the lemon mixture. Stir and taste. If you prefer a less concentrated flavor or less sweetness, add an additional 1 cup of cold water gradually until it reaches your desired taste.

instructions.title: Chill Thoroughly
instructions.text: Cover the pitcher and refrigerate the lemonade for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and to ensure it's perfectly chilled. For best results, chill for at least an hour.

instructions.title: Serve Refreshingly
instructions.text: Fill glasses with plenty of ice. Pour the chilled Fresh Squeezed Lemonade over the ice. Garnish each glass with a fresh lemon slice and a sprig of mint for an extra touch of aroma and visual appeal. Enjoy immediately!

tips: For the best flavor, always use freshly squeezed lemons. Pre-bottled lemon juice lacks the vibrant, zesty aroma and taste that makes homemade lemonade truly special.

Adjust the sweetness to your liking. If you prefer a less sweet lemonade, reduce the amount of sugar in the simple syrup or add more water when diluting. For extra tartness, add a splash more lemon juice.
Don't skip the chilling step! Allowing the lemonade to chill thoroughly not only makes it more refreshing but also gives the flavors time to meld and deepen, resulting in a perfectly balanced drink.
